actions.description: Discover expert BTP documents via Tavily search
actions.command: python3 eval/expert-discovery.py --sector btp --query "DTU norms Eurocodes CCTP templates AFNOR standards RE2020 construction France"

actions.description: Ingest DTU norms (Document Technique Unifié) documents

actions.command: python3 ops/staging-deploy.py --workflow ingest-btp-documents --documents "Eurocodes construction standards Europe France"

actions.description: Ingest CCTP templates (Cahier des Clauses Techniques Particulières)

actions.reason: CCTP templates are essential for contract and technical specification questions in BTP

actions.description: Ingest AFNOR standards and RE2020 documentation

Verify that the BTP standard pipeline score improved from ~39 to target ~55-60

test_questions.question: Quelles sont les principales exigences du DTU 20.1 pour la mise en œuvre des enduits sur murs extérieurs ?
test_questions.expected_behavior: Answer should cite specific DTU 20.1 requirements with proper technical terminology and source citation

test_questions.question: Comment appliquer les Eurocodes pour le calcul des structures en béton armé selon les normes françaises ?
test_questions.expected_behavior: Answer should reference Eurocode 2 and French application rules with technical accuracy

success_metric: BTP standard pipeline score increases from 39.0 to >55 (target ~60), pass rate improves from 40% to >70%
risk_assessment: High risk of rate limiting on Groq free tier during ingestion, potential 503 errors on HF Spaces during processing, and possible cold starts affecting timing. Need to throttle ingestion requests and implement retry logic.
